bude: biti — to be; zna da bude — it happens
da: conjunction: that, so that; da + verb = infinitive («da vidim» — to see); also «yes»
dobro: dobro veče — good evening; dobro je što — good thing that
evo: evo ga — here he is; evo nas — here we are
i: conjunction; before the word — «and, also, even»
isečem: iseći — to cut up; 1st pers. sg.
mi: mi — we; short form «me» (potreban mi je — I need)
mogu: moći — to be able; 1st pers. sg. (also 3rd pers. pl. — «they can»)
na: preposition: na jugu — in the south, na Instagram — in Instagram
neka: neki — some, a certain; fem. sg. or neut. pl.
nemoj: negative command: nemoj da promašiš — don't miss
onako: čisto onako — just like that, simply
pa: particle at the start of a line — «well»; conjunction — «and, therefore»
po: po mraku — in the dark; po jedan — one by one; dva i po — two and a half
salati: salata — salad; loc. case: u salati — in the salad
sam: biti, 1st pers. sg.: rekao sam — I said
se: reflexive particle: slikamo se — we take photos of ourselves
seckaš: seckati — to chop finely; 2nd pers. sg.
si: biti, 2nd pers. sg.; gde si — hi, how are you (colloquial)
stavim: I will put, I will insert
sve: sav — all; neut. sg. or pl.
ti: pronoun; «ili ti ga» — «or, in other words» (colloquial)
u: preposition: + loc. case — where, + acc. case — where to
uništio: uništiti — to destroy, ruin; past masc.
vrzmaš: vrzmati se — to hang about, get underfoot; 2nd pers. sg.
za: preposition: za to — for this; skretanje za — turn onto
znači: značiti — to mean; as an introductory word — «so, in short»
čoveče: čovek — person; voc. case; as an exclamation — «wow, you're something»
što: conjunction «what»; colloquial question «of what, why» (što si se sredio?)
